description:
Head of Product (Remote)

Lightning Labs · Product · Full-time · Remote (US time zones) · Reports to the CEO

 
 

About Lightning Labs

Lightning Labs builds the open infrastructure that makes bitcoin the native money of the internet. Our software powers a large share of the Lightning Network, from LND, the most widely used Lightning implementation, to the tools that let developers, businesses, and now AI agents send and receive bitcoin and stablecoins instantly, at internet scale.

We're building a team that's passionate about cryptography, bitcoin, decentralization, security, and privacy. The next wave of users on the network won't only be people. They'll increasingly be software agents that discover services, negotiate, and pay on their own. We think bitcoin and Lightning are the right payment rails for that world, and we're building for it now.

The Role

We're looking for a Head of Product who embodies those values and who wants to bring bitcoin and Lightning to the masses, both human and machine. You'll own product vision, strategy, and roadmap across the Lightning Labs portfolio, working directly with the CEO, engineering leads, and our go-to-market team.

This is a player-coach role. You'll lead the product organization: product managers, including a PM who owns our core infrastructure (LND, btcd, btcwallet, and DevOps), plus design and technical content writing. You'll stay hands-on: writing specs, making pricing and launch calls, talking to developers and partners, and building prototypes yourself.

You'll also be AI-native. At Lightning Labs, product work runs through tools like Claude Code and Codex. We use them to explore codebases, draft specs, analyze data, and turn an idea into a working prototype or demo in hours instead of weeks. We expect our Head of Product to work this way by default, and to help the rest of the team do the same.

Our Product Stack

You’ll set product direction across the whole stack. Product Managers on the team own the core infrastructure day to day, so your focus will be payments, assets, and agentic commerce. That starts with Wavelength, our newest product: an open-source, agent-first client and SDK built on Ark that lets any app send and receive standard Lightning payments. It is in public alpha, and taking it to broad mainnet adoption is one of your first priorities. Alongside it are Taproot Assets, our protocol for issuing stablecoins and other assets on bitcoin and Lightning, and L402 together with its reverse proxy Aperture, which let machines and agents pay for APIs over HTTP.

Underneath sit the tools node operators use: Lightning Terminal for node and liquidity management, Loop for moving funds between on-chain and off-chain, and Lightning Node Connect for secure remote access. All of it is built on LND, the leading Lightning implementation, used by exchanges, wallets, and payment processors around the world. This is a leadership role for product, which means deciding what we build next and which new products and markets we enter.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap across Lightning Labs' products, and make the hard calls on priorities and tradeoffs between them

  • Lead our agentic commerce and payments strategy, figuring out where bitcoin, Lightning, stablecoins, L402, and Wavelength fit as AI agents start to transact on their own

  • Grow Wavelength and push forward broad mainnet adoption, including onboarding, limits, safety rails, developer experience, and network growth

  • Prototype and demo constantly. Use Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools to build working prototypes, reference integrations, and demos that test ideas with developers before engineering commits to them

  • Drive product launches end to end, working with engineering, design, marketing, and developer relations on positioning, messaging, docs, blog posts, and launch goals

  • Set pricing and business models for our hosted services, working from unit economics, liquidity costs, and the competitive landscape

  • Write clearly and often. Explain technical concepts to internal and external audiences through specs, blog posts, launch announcements, docs, and partner materials

  • Work with engineering leads on scope, sequencing, and release readiness, including planning cycles, launch gates, and issue triage across multiple repositories

  • Make our products as easy for AI agents to use as for human developers, with agent-readable docs, MCP servers, skills, and SDKs as first-class parts of the product

  • Lead and grow a team of product managers, designers, and a technical content writer. Set the bar for quality, coach the team, hire well, and model the AI-native way of working

  • Make sure our design and technical content (docs, guides, blog posts, and launch materials) are as good as the products themselves

Minimum Qualifications

  • 7-10 years of product experience, including leading product for developer platforms, APIs, payments, or infrastructure

  • Experience setting product strategy and roadmaps from conception to launch, and leading cross-functional teams through launches

  • A deep, hands-on understanding of how software is built, with experience across development methodologies and an appreciation of the tradeoffs between approaches

  • Daily, hands-on use of AI coding and agent tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor in your product work, including building working prototypes and demos yourself. Please show us something you've built

  • Strong interest in agentic commerce and payments: how AI agents will discover, pay for, and sell services, and what payment infrastructure that requires

  • Experience driving product vision, go-to-market strategy, pricing, and design discussions

  • Experience managing and developing product managers, and ideally designers or writers as well

  • Ability to influence engineers, executives, and external partners without direct authority

  • Demonstrated passion for bitcoin and Lightning, along with an understanding of the technology, community, and ecosystem

  • Excellent written communication skills

  • Willingness to work in US time zones

Preferred Qualifications

  • Undergraduate or advanced degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience

  • Experience building bitcoin or Lightning products or services

  • Familiarity with the protocols and standards emerging around agent payments and machine-to-machine commerce (L402, MCP, and the wider ecosystem of agent payment protocols)

  • Experience with stablecoins or asset issuance protocols and platforms is a plus

  • Knowledge of networking and routing concepts and how they apply to Lightning payments

  • Experience shipping developer-facing SDKs, docs, and developer experience, and knowing what makes a developer platform easy to adopt

  • Knowledge of multiple functional areas such as Engineering, UX/UI, Sales, Developer Relations, Customer Support, Finance, or Marketing
